description.value: Maan Farms is a multi-generational family farm in Abbotsford's Fraser Valley offering U-pick and pre-picked strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries alongside an award-winning estate winery that produces berry wines entirely from fruit grown on the property. Founded in 1977, the farm has grown from a roadside stand into a full agritourism destination featuring a Country Market, barnyard animals, a corn maze, goat yoga, and a restored heritage barn. For touring cyclists, it is a distinctive Fraser Valley stop to stock up on fresh local berries in season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Maan Farms is an actively operating agritourism farm with U-pick berries, a Country Market, and an estate winery; active booking for 2026–2027 weddings and current U-pick operations confirm it is open. OSM contact details (phone +1-604-864-5723, address 790 McKenzie Rd, Abbotsford V2S 7N4) are corroborated verbatim on the website footer. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Category 'Groceries' is a loose fit — this is primarily an agritourism/farm-experience destination rather than a conventional grocery store; a dedicated 'Farm Market' category would be more accurate if one exists in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active family farm selling fresh local produce and berries in the Fraser Valley; a useful and distinctive stop for touring cyclists seeking local food, even though cyclist-specific infrastructure is unconfirmed.
